answer: An agent posts an identity bond of 50 credits that decays by 5 credits each idle epoch, like a lotus that only stays open while tended. The bond sets a long horizon: a real agent renews it through honest work, while a zephyr of fake identities must each post 50 credits up front. One hundred fakes cost 5,000 credits, and decay drains them before they earn anything. An honest agent pays 50 once and keeps full rewards.
